description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and MRR@10 for different DPR models. The x-axis represents the number of queries used during inference (S), with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 10, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents MRR@10, with a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot displays four lines, each representing a different DPR model: DPR w/o query (black, solid line, no markers), DPR w/ corpus expansion (red, solid line, circle markers), DPR w/ document expansion (green, solid line, triangle markers), and DPR w/ asymmetric expansion (blue, solid line, star markers). The black line remains steady at approximately 34.3 across the x-axis. The red line starts at around 35.4 when S is 1 and increases to approximately 35.7 when S is 5, remaining relatively stable thereafter. The green line begins at around 34.7 when S is 1, peaks at approximately 35.0 when S is 2, and then gradually declines to around 34.8 when S is 10. The blue line starts at around 34.6 when S is 1, peaks at approximately 35.1 when S is 3, and then declines to around 34.3 when S is 10.
